Name: Food Cutting Process
definition: A process of cutting food into smaller pieces, chunks or slices.

canonical_name: fermenting elaeis palm sap food product

Name: Processed Meat Food Product
definition: A processed food product consisting of meat which has been subjected to preservation and/or taste altering processes such as grinding, salting, curing, fermentation, smoking, and addition of chemical preservatives.

Name: Fermented Soybean Food Product
definition: A food product having fermented soyabeans as a defining ingredient

Name: Processed Cheese Food Product
definition: A cheese product made from traditional cheese and emulsifying salts, often with the addition of milk, more salt, preservatives, and food coloring.

Name: Food (Fermented)
definition: Food material which has been fermented.

Name: Unpasteurized Cow Milk Cheese Food Product
canonical_name: unpasteurized cow milk cheese food product

Name: Food Fermentation
definition: A fermentation process in which either carbohydrates, proteins or fats are modified through microbial, enzymatic and/or other biological process.

Name: Pasteurized Process Cheese Spread Food Product
canonical_name: pasteurized process cheese spread food product

Name: Food Milling
definition: The process of milling grain into flour, usually performed by a grist mill, corn mill or flour mill.

Name: Food Evaporation Process
definition: A food evaporation process is the process of removing water from a food.

Name: Food Transformation Process
definition: A process involving the physical transformation of a food source or food product into some derived organic material or food product

Name: Food Material By Process
definition: Food material organized by the process which it results from.

Name: Food Seasoning Process
definition: A process of applying a seasoning mixture to a given food.

Name: Food Packaging Process
definition: A process that applies packaging material to a food product for preservation, shipping and/or presentation purposes.

Name: Shell Removal Process
definition: A process which separates a culinary nut's shell from its meat, leaving the meat part more or less intact.

Name: Food Processing Contact Surface
definition: A surface that contacts human food or a surface from which drainage, or other transfer, onto the food or onto a surface that contacts the food ordinarily occurs during the normal course of food processing.

Name: Food (Fermented From Innoculant)
definition: A food product derived from a food fermentation process involving bacteria, yeast or mold culture.

Name: Processing Aid
definition: A food ingredient which is not consumed as a food material on its own, but which is deliberately used during the processing or transformation of raw materials, foodstuffs, or their ingredients in order to fulfill a given technological objective.

Name: Regulated Processing Aid
definition: A processing aid which has (regional) regulatory restrictions pertaining to its application or allowable limits.

Name: Food Recipe Process
definition: A food treatment process that executes a food recipe specification.

Name: Process On Aggregate
definition: A process which is applied to an aggregate of objects, and which has a subprocess component part which each aggregate member part is subjected to.

Name: Recipe Total Processing Duration
definition: A duration which is the total time required for all of a recipe's process durations, including time to prepare ingredients, assembly and cooking time.

Name: Slicing Process
definition: A cutting process which outputs sliced material.
